senses.gloss: m. pl.S’maraë or Samraë, name of a Cushite tribe, prob. named from Sabrata (Abrotonum), in northern Africa; cmp. זִינְגָּאֵי.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 10:7">Targ. Y. Gen. X, 7</cite> <he>סְמִדָּ׳</he>; <cite ref="Targum of I Chronicles 1:9">Targ. I Chr. I, 9</cite> (ed. Rahmer <he>סמד׳</he>; h. text <he>סבתה</he>).
